title: THE HOW TO PLAY KEYS ARE VISIBLE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): take pictures and make sure the menus actually look good. The picture check of the arcade attract screen found the HOW TO PLAY page showing only the action names: every key under KEYBOARD and CONTROLLER was drawn black on the black page, because of an old browser rule for tables on this page. The keys are drawn in the page colour and size now, so the page says which key does what.
now: The arcade HOW TO PLAY page shows its keyboard and controller keys again.
